free_coefficients.statement: Pure-power class, K = 4 even, n = 2, p = 4, Fuchs index k0 = 12. Let w be a solution meromorphic in C and z_i a pole, with leading coefficient a0 (Eq(-a*a0, -1680*b*c)) and free coefficient h = c_12. Then gamma_{a0}(h) = 0, where gamma_{a0} = gamma_{a0,12} is a polynomial of degree exactly 2 in h with a leading coefficient that does not depend on the coefficients of Psi; moreover gamma_{a0,j}(h) = 0 for every j >= 1 and gamma_{a0,0}(h) takes the same value at all poles of w. Hence at most 2 values of h per a0, at most 2 Laurent series and at most 2 poles modulo the periods.
